title: Robust Task-Oriented Dialogue Generation with Contrastive Pre-training and Adversarial Filtering

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing dialogue model performance when trained on full dialogue history versus partial history containing only frequent phrases to detect reliance on non-meaning-bearing shortcuts.
Analyzing the frequency distribution of knowledge base (KB) entities in system responses to identify heavy skewness toward a small number of 'head' entities compared to the long tail.
